verdict.rationale: Customer.io's Track and Pipelines APIs and SDKs send real-time events tied to identified customers (docs-7, docs-3, docs-5). Its automations can be triggered 'when profiles perform events' (docs-12, docs-30), which covers firing a custom event that starts an automation for that specific person. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that an event-triggered automation enrolls only the person who performed the event (it is implied, not stated), plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the event-to-automation flow.
